backlog.title: Verify private data isolation and cloud recovery
backlog.description: After the hosted deployment is available, sign in with a second account and confirm it cannot read or alter the designated account's training document. Verify edits persist across refresh, offline edits produce the documented recovery path, and simultaneous writes surface a version conflict without silently overwriting newer data. Record any failure as a follow-up fix.

backlog.title: Add personal-record detection and display
backlog.description: Detect personal records per skill/exercise, level, and equipment: longest clean hold or highest rep count. Exclude bailed holds. Show newly earned records in the completed-session summary and Sunday review, and cover matching, tie, level/equipment separation, and bail exclusion with tests.

backlog.title: Build core progress analytics
backlog.description: Derive charts and metrics from saved records: best hold per session with a 3-session rolling best by skill/level/equipment; best set and total reps per exercise; weekly hard sets by movement pattern; weekly consistency; session length; benchmark results; and mobility depth ratings. Include understandable empty states and tests that chart selectors use real stored data.

backlog.title: Add JSON and CSV training-data export
backlog.description: Let the signed-in user export their own training history from the app. JSON output must be valid and retain the documented versioned data shape; CSV must quote commas, quotes, and newlines correctly and include session dates, exercise/set metrics, notes, skipped reasons, reviews, and journal entries without exposing another account's data. Verify exported contents and failure handling.

done.title: Add a shared prototype kanban board
done.description: Users and agents manage the same workspace board with card CRUD and status moves.

Implement web accounts, cloud persistence, and journaling
done.description: Feature implementation is complete: password sign-in/recovery, account-owned Supabase documents, history/journal, optimistic version checks, and recovery drafts are in place; the designated account's 46-session history migration has completed. Hosted deployment checks and live cross-account isolation/concurrency verification are tracked separately.

done.title: Deploy the prototype to GitHub Pages
done.description: Configure repository Pages settings and the VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY Actions variables. Set the Supabase Auth Site URL and allowed redirect URL to https://streamline-fitness.github.io/Streamline/. Run the Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow and confirm the hosted app loads, sign-in succeeds, and password recovery returns to the deployed app. Verify the designated account's 46 migrated sessions are visible and a training-data edit survives refresh.
